My foundation in science and laboratory technology underpins my analytical problem-solving strategy: dissecting complex systems down to their fundamental components and key parameters. I bring this precise, product-oriented framework into developing scalable product strategies, user research, and go-to-market plans.


Whether conducting user interviews, building product roadmaps, or crafting PRDs, my aim is to design intuitive, high-impact products with grit, structure, and a relentless focus on user value.

LearnLoop

Localized E-Learning Marketplace • MVP Definition & Launch Planning • 2026

Problem Space: Global e-learning platforms are often unaffordable for local users, lack cultural localization, provide poor support for regional payment systems, and fail to address region-specific employment needs. Simultaneously, local experts lack the necessary infrastructure to monetize their knowledge, distribute content, and manage growing education businesses.


Solution: LearnLoop is a localized e-learning marketplace designed to make practical skill acquisition affordable, accessible, and relevant to emerging markets (specifically Africa). It acts as a two-sided marketplace connecting learners with regional instructors.


Product Vision: To become Africa's most trusted localized learning ecosystem for practical skill development, enabling millions to access affordable education while empowering regional instructors to build sustainable digital businesses.


Target Users:

  • Aspiring Learners: Students or individuals seeking affordable, job-ready, and culturally relevant skills
  • Local Instructors: Skill experts looking to monetize expertise and build sustainable education businesses
  • Consistent Learners: Goal-oriented professionals seeking career growth through convenient and trackable learning experiences

Key MVP Features:

  • Learner: Course discovery, enrollment with local payment integration, video streaming, progress tracking, resume-learning, ratings/reviews, certificate generation, and discussions
  • Instructor: Profile management, course creation/publishing, video uploads, module organization, enrollment tracking, revenue visibility, and announcements
  • Admin: User/course management, payment monitoring, content moderation, and analytics dashboard

Discovery Phase

FreshPass

Real-Time Surplus Food Marketplace • 2026

Problem Space: Restaurants over-produce and throw away food they can't sell by the end of the day. Nearby consumers want affordable meals and are willing to trade certainty of choice for a lower price.


Solution: FreshPass connects the two sides in a real-time surplus marketplace, reducing food waste while offering consumers affordable last-minute meals.


Research Methodology:

  • Simulated interviews across restaurant operator and consumer segments
  • Behaviour-first questioning over stated preference
  • Jobs-to-be-done framing to isolate the real trigger
  • Willingness-to-pay probes on the consumer side
